strings.no_apps: No application is playing sound right now
strings.buttons_d_left: Left click switches sound, right click opens the window
strings.buttons_d_right: Right click switches sound, left click opens the window
strings.auto_device_d: The moment this device turns on, sound moves to it. When it turns off, sound goes back
strings.learn_d: Dongle %s is unknown. The program will write its reports to a file on this computer — toggle the headset a few times and the model can be added from those lines. Nothing is sent anywhere
strings.dongle_d: Recognised %s. Its power state is visible only through the dongle — Windows does not report it
strings.mic_follow_d: Recording moves to the microphone of the same headset. Going back to speakers restores the previous microphone
strings.hk_switch_d: Works from any program, even over a fullscreen game
strings.hk_taken: Another program already owns this shortcut — pick a different one
strings.player_d: The transport keys and the shortcut address this player, even when the sound is coming from something else. Starting it pauses the others. Without one, the command goes to whoever is playing, and if nobody is, to whoever was controlled last
strings.player_key_d: Starts the priority player from anywhere. The keyboard play key goes to whichever player Windows considers current
strings.autostart_d: The tray icon appears right after you sign in, without a window
strings.comms_d: Discord, Zoom and Teams move along with everything else. Without this they stay on the old device
strings.notify_d: A popup with the name of the new device
strings.beep_d: A short tone on the new device
strings.about_text: Switch between speakers and headphones with one click on the tray icon.
strings.g_left_d: Switches sound to the next checked device
strings.welcome_note: Windows hides new tray icons. Drag the icon onto the taskbar to keep it handy.
